sessions.name: Login Sessions
sessions.command: LC_ALL=C last -F -w -s '{{since}}' 2>/dev/null | head -200 || LC_ALL=C last -w 2>/dev/null | head -200 || LC_ALL=C last 2>/dev/null | head -200

failed_auth.name: Failed Authentication
failed_auth.command: LC_ALL=C lastb -F -w -s '{{since}}' 2>/dev/null | head -200 || LC_ALL=C lastb -w 2>/dev/null | head -200 || LC_ALL=C lastb 2>/dev/null | head -200

sudo_commands.name: Sudo Commands
sudo_commands.command: { if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && journalctl --no-pager -n1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then journalctl -t sudo --since '{{since}}' --no-pager -o short 2>/dev/null | grep 'COMMAND='; fi; for logfile in /var/log/secure /var/log/auth.log; do [ -f "$logfile" ] && grep -h 'sudo' "$logfile" 2>/dev/null | grep 'COMMAND='; for i in 1 2 3 4; do [ -f "${logfile}.$i" ] && grep -h 'sudo' "${logfile}.$i" 2>/dev/null | grep 'COMMAND='; done; for f in "${logfile}"*.gz; do [ -f "$f" ] && gunzip -c "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep 'COMMAND='; done; done; } | sort -u | tail -500

file_changes.name: File Changes
file_changes.command: find /etc /var/spool/cron -type f -mmin -{{minutes}} -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -100 || find /etc /var/spool/cron -type f -mmin -{{minutes}} -exec stat -c '%Y %n' {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -100 || find /etc /var/spool/cron -type f -mmin -{{minutes}} 2>/dev/null | head -100 | while IFS= read -r f; do mtime=$(date -r "$f" +%s 2>/dev/null || stat -t "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $12}'); [ -n "$mtime" ] && echo "$mtime $f"; done | sort -rn

reboots.name: Reboots
reboots.command: LC_ALL=C last -F -w reboot -s '{{since}}' 2>/dev/null | head -50 || LC_ALL=C last -w reboot 2>/dev/null | head -50 || LC_ALL=C last reboot 2>/dev/null | head -50

package_changes.name: Package Changes
package_changes.command: rpm -qa --last 2>/dev/null | head -200 || grep -h -e ' install ' -e ' upgrade ' -e ' remove ' /var/log/dpkg.log /var/log/dpkg.log.1 2>/dev/null | tail -200 || apk audit --system 2>/dev/null | head -50 || grep -e 'installed' -e 'upgraded' -e 'removed' /var/log/pacman.log 2>/dev/null | tail -100

service_changes.name: Service Changes
service_changes.command: if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && journalctl --no-pager -n1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then journalctl -t systemd --since '{{since}}' --no-pager -o short 2>/dev/null | grep -i -e Started -e Stopped -e 'Failed to start' -e 'Entered failed state' | grep -v -e session -e scope -e slice -e 'user@' | tail -100; else for logfile in /var/log/messages /var/log/syslog; do [ -f "$logfile" ] && grep -i -e 'start' -e 'stop' -e 'fail' "$logfile" 2>/dev/null | grep -v -e session -e scope -e cron | tail -100; done; fi
